# vibe-keyboard config

This folder holds your vibe-keyboard setup. The app created this README and `.gitignore` on first run.

## Files

| File | What it is | Git |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `profile.toml` | Your deck layout: pages and keys. | Commit it |
| `images/` | Key images used by `profile.toml`. | Commit them |
| `state.toml` | Runtime state, such as the current page and brightness. | Ignored |
| `app.log` | Runtime log. | Ignored |

## Sync your setup across Macs

Keep this folder in its own git repo. Push it to a private GitHub repo.

On this Mac, run these commands in this folder:

```sh
cd ~/.config/vibe-keyboard
git init
printf 'state.toml\napp.log\n*.tmp\n.DS_Store\n' > .gitignore   # same content the app wrote
git remote add origin git@github.com:YOUR_USER/vibe-keyboard-config.git
git add -A && git commit -m "Initial config" && git push -u origin main
```

On another Mac, quit the app first. Then back up the local folder and pull the setup. The pull replaces local files with the same names. The backup copies them to `~/.config/vibe-keyboard.bak`:

```sh
cp -R ~/.config/vibe-keyboard ~/.config/vibe-keyboard.bak   # back up local files first
cd ~/.config/vibe-keyboard
git init
git remote add origin git@github.com:YOUR_USER/vibe-keyboard-config.git
git fetch origin && git checkout -f -B main origin/main
```
